To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the cost of occupational injury and disease is a very complex issue that requires a multidimensional approach.
the costs of occupational accidents and diseases are the sum of direct and indirect costs.

the economic costs of occupational injuries are determined by: (i) the costs of medical care and rehabilitation of injured workers, (ii) the costs of lost production, (iii) the costs of compensation for injured workers and (iv) the costs of administration of occupational injuries and illness programs.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the identification of the most significant cost elements of occupational injuries and occupational diseases in the Romanian economy, and the determination of their influence on the overall costs of occupational accidents.
the identification and analysis of the main factors that influence the economic cost of occupational injuries.

identifying the main elements that should be taken into consideration in determining the costs of occupational accidents and diseases, in order to develop a methodology for assessing these costs at the national level.

the costs of occupational diseases and injuries are very high and that their economic burden is much more important than previously estimated.
